name: motion-drawer

frames.best_why: Frame 4 shows the drawer open with all four Menu links and Upgrade Plan; frame 3 catches it mid-slide.

tagline: A springy mobile-style menu slides in from the left edge.
summary: An off-canvas navigation drawer that springs in from the left with a link list and one upgrade button. It closes from its X, the dimmed overlay, or a sideways drag.
appearance: A dark panel slides over the page from the left, about 280px wide, with a small Menu heading, four stacked link rows and a white Upgrade Plan button at the bottom. Behind it the page title Motion Drawer and its hint stay visible on black.
behaviour: A menu icon at the top left opens a spring-driven dark panel from the left while a light overlay dims the page; the X, an overlay click or a sideways drag closes it. Links tint on hover.
demo_content: Page title "Motion Drawer", hint "Click the menu icon to open", links Dashboard, Projects, Analytics, Settings
search_phrases: menu that springs open from the side
off canvas nav with drag to close
hamburger icon opens a side menu
left nav that slides over content
use_when: A compact nav or filter panel should slide over the page with a physical feel.
avoid_when: Panel width is a fixed pixel value and the 60px top padding cannot be changed by prop.
customise: width, direction, colours, overlay, spring config, drag and toggle behaviour are props; the links and Upgrade Plan are your children.
weight_why: One drawer, one overlay and a small menu; nothing loops.

a11y.note: The icon-only open and close buttons have no accessible names, and Escape is not handled.

issues: Open and close icons have no text or aria labels.
Escape does not close the drawer; only the X, overlay or a drag do.
polish_why: Smooth spring slide and drag-dismiss with a clear hierarchy; icon buttons lack names.
title: Motion Drawer
